valid_owner_signature_observed.meaning: a valid on-chain ECDSA signature from the AtomWallet owner is observable after an executed UserOp

high_s_counterpart_derivable.meaning: an observer can derive a high-s counterpart with s' = curve_order - s and v' = v XOR 1 recovering the identical signer

high_s_signature_length_bytes.meaning: length in bytes of the derived high-s signature

validate_user_op_reverts.meaning: validateUserOp reverts during handleOps execution of the griefing UserOp
validate_user_op_reverts.checkpoint: during handleOps execution of the griefing UserOp

bundle_transaction_fails.meaning: the validateUserOp revert propagates through the entire bundle during handleOps causing the bundler's transaction to fail
bundle_transaction_fails.checkpoint: after handleOps execution of the griefing UserOp

assumptions: The griefing UserOp is submitted to the EntryPoint during handleOps, which calls validateUserOp without a try/catch.
The derived high-s signature is the signature carried by the griefing UserOp targeting the AtomWallet.

unresolved.description: Report describes the bundle failure as potential/conditional and does not state whether the griefing UserOp was actually observed on-chain.

limitations: Formalizes only the target impact v_revert_propagates_bundle_fail; other listed impacts are handled in separate passes.
The high-s derivation relation (s' = curve_order - s, v' = v XOR 1) is represented as a grounded Boolean because the report gives no numeric curve_order literal.
